# mistershell_canary (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell canary by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_canary" "example" {
  name = "existing-canary"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `applied_config_generation` (Number) Applied config generation.
- `applied_content_hash` (String) Applied content hash.
- `configuration_unavailable` (Boolean) Configuration unavailable.
- `connected_at` (String) Connected at.
- `counters` (Dynamic) Counters.
- `decoy_interface` (String) Decoy interface.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `desired_config_generation` (Number) Desired config generation.
- `desired_content_hash` (String) Desired content hash.
- `health` (Dynamic) Health.
- `ip_ignorelist` (Dynamic) Ip ignorelist.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Is enabled.
- `last_heartbeat_at` (String) Last heartbeat at.
- `license_reason` (String) License reason.
- `location` (Dynamic) Location.
- `location_id` (Number) Location id.
- `rate_limit_per_min` (Number) Rate limit per min.
- `runtime_status` (Dynamic) Runtime status.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Shown once; store securely in the private deployment token file.
- `version` (String) Version.
